title: Template:Ep-nav/doc
content: ;Description :This templates is used to provide quick, consistent link to the previous and next episodes in a series. ;Syntax :Type {{t|ep-nav|prev=|next=}} at the bottom of episode pages, filling in the prev= and next= fields. Don't forget to include brackets, to make the fields into links. ;Sample output :{{ep-nav|prev=[[Help:Templates|Link A]] plus text|next=[[Help:Templates|Link C]]}} gives... :{{ep-nav|prev=[[Help:Templates|Link A]] plus text|next=[[Help:Templates|Link C]]}} [[Category:General wiki templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
